items.statement: Final: select the direct-cyclization catalytic route
items.expected: In the final conclusion, explicitly select route A, comprising PEt3-initiated zwitterion formation followed by direct cyclization, nucleophile incorporation and phosphine regeneration. Integrate actual connectivity, the complete observed product and migration-competition evidence to explain why this route is preferred. Merely listing candidate A does not earn credit; the conclusion is restricted to the investigated models and does not establish a globally unique mechanism.

In the final conclusion, explain reaction accessibility using an actual complete free-energy profile and balanced endpoint: initial addition incurs the main energetic cost, and subsequent steps lead to an overall downhill product. Relate this to the 110°C conditions without treating 12 h or yield as an elementary rate constant. Passing the exact product-G window is not required, and a negative composite local difference cannot establish a negative physical barrier.
